C9000036.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 036 (Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models.; papers: Numerical semiampleness of nef adjoint classes on compact Kähler manifolds; Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors; Minimal models and Mori fibre spaces for generalized log canonical Q-pairs; Minimal models in numerical dimension one; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C9000036-FINITE-DATA.statement: The complete fixed complex geometric data of thm:finite-data cannot coexist, retaining all intersection, flag, jet, movable-curve and quantifier hypotheses.

C9000036-REDUCTION.statement: All fixed data spread to good reductions of unbounded characteristic, retaining the curve slope hypothesis and the effective-divisor test by the fixed movable witness.

C9000036-JETS.statement: Products and finitely many filler sections yield Frobenius jets and hence full generic rank p^(2n) by coefficient projection onto torus weights divisible by p.

C9000036-FILTRATION.statement: The Frobenius diagonal and Frobenius pullback have the asserted truncated-symmetric-power graded pieces, complementary perfect pairings, rank sums and Chern-class sums.

C9000036-SLOPE.statement: Langer's curve estimate and a direct tensor-quotient argument give a characteristic- and filtration-independent error constant for the maximal slopes of all truncated pieces.

C9000036-RANK.statement: One explicit flag polynomial bounds every graded piece by its rank, so the diagonal rank divided by p^(2n) is at most 7^n H^n + E/p with E depending only on the fixed data.

C9000036-DET.statement: Every full-rank column choice gives external-product determinant factors with normalized classes B_p/p +(p-1)K/(2p)+lambda_i S, lambda_i in [0,q], and uniform movable-curve error.

C9000036-ORDER.statement: The order of a nonzero external-product section is bounded above by the sum of factor maximum orders, while a rank-t value forces determinant order at least R-t.

C9000036-FROB.statement: Mechanically certified finite coefficient, monomial-complement, floor-count, evaluation-dimension and determinant algebra derives an explicit uniform rank budget from structural linear injections and proves the threshold contradiction. Geometric realization and independent statement-fidelity review remain separate.

C9000036-PROJECTIVE.statement: Projective klt rational (X,B), K+B pseudo-effective, M nef rational Cartier on X, and K+B+M nef imply numerical equivalence to a semiample rational Cartier divisor.

C9000036-CY-BIG.statement: The projective manuscript's terminal Calabi-Yau full-nef-dimension bigness step follows from its scalar bound, large projective-bundle jets and construction of finite-data inputs.

C9000036-JET-GEOMETRY.statement: The projective scalar moving-jet bound, bounded-degree geometric exclusions, large Seshadri estimate and movable-curve construction supply all finite-data inputs.

C9000036-COMPANION-LA.statement: Companion ordinary log abundance, as cited by the projective and other manuscripts; not an established independent input of this campaign.

C9000036-KAHLER.statement: For smooth compact Kahler X, effective rational SNC B with coefficients <1, and nef rational line M, K+B pseudo-effective and K+B+M nef imply a semiample rational representative of the real Bott-Chern class.

C9000036-ANALYTIC.statement: The Kahler manuscript's ordinary decomposition, algebraic-dimension-zero two-diagonal argument, rational nef descent, global flat twists and period-based adjoint construction hold.

C9000036-GMM.statement: Projective generalized lc rational pairs in characteristic zero admit non-extracting discrepancy-improving nef models or Mori fibre spaces, retaining the same nef rational b-divisor.

C9000036-PHASE.statement: The generalized minimal-model manuscript's cyclic-character phase theorem follows from its cone, product, optimization, Cartier, rounding, integral-jump, lifting/mixing and bounded-fibre assertions.

C9000036-GLOBAL-TRANSFER.statement: The generalized manuscript transfers its smooth termination input through relative weak Zariski decompositions to the stated fixed-nef-data existence theorem.

C9000036-ND1.statement: Smooth connected complex projective n-folds, n>=3, with K pseudo-effective and section-growth kappa_sigma(K)=1 admit finite K-negative MMPs to rational-factorial terminal nef models with the stated effective exceptional discrepancy comparison.

C9000036-ND1-SURFACES.statement: Codimension-two stabilization, fixed-twist surface extension, quadratic-growth exclusion and the negative-curve surface argument in the numerical-dimension-one manuscript hold.
